original_card.question: Can one selected pricing or assembly claim be checked by a genuinely independent exact implementation?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Recompute one small part of the ledger or one certified enclosure using an independent implementation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: One selected assembly premise checked by a genuinely independent exact implementation: Lemma G's RecipesExact on the selected frontier1094 gauge44 word. Every one of the 2,896 stored child recipes satisfies L o F_r o R = T_new o T_old^-1 and every one of the 224 endpoint adapters satisfies its defining identity (Lemma G's H6), exactly on all 512 columns of C^(2^9), global phase included, with a kernel written from scratch and calibrated against Lean-literal and published operator digests.
scope_change_reason: The card's method (reconstruct from original operations, not aggregates) is applied to the selected word's stored phase recipes rather than its rank ledger: the rank ledger was rebuilt independently in our #1262 and the frame ranks by seed80 (no phase claim). The producer's lower_child check (signed Z4 tableau plus column 0) is complete but ran in the producer's own code at generation time; the Lemma G package's independent checkers (I-tr, check_adapters.py) ran on four other words. No pricing number changes.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the selected record's soundness, no kappa change. Every climb priced as a rank-r child relies on its recipe executing T_new o T_old^-1 exactly. This gives a second, independent, byte-bound check of that premise at record level for every child record and endpoint adapter of the selected word's CLIFFORD-RECIPES.json; the 36 residual wrapper recipes, the identity adapters, the executor bridge and a Lean formalisation of this instance stay open.
stop_rule: Stop when all 2,896 children and 224 adapters are checked exactly on all columns with a calibrated kernel and the mutation controls reject; pre-declared fallback: report adapters plus every edge with dim(new) <= 7 as checked and the rest as pending if the full set cannot be finished.
evidence: RESULT.json: binding to frontier1094 certificate 1122cb3a, capsule f1da8061, recipes d0768f21, word payload 4ddb29fb (gz 16bc0ebb); inventory 1,004 frames, 2,896 children (ranks 1:1928, 2:380, 3:408, 4:124, 5:40, 8:16; 8 descending centre reversals) = relabel keys of both orientations (3,486 climbs + 8 centres each), 224 adapters, 6,016 monomials well formed; calibration: Exact.lean gate lists and three rank-7 pair identities, #1415's three operator digests, #702's 14 frame kernels (word frames 37+29k) reproduced; evaluation: 2,896 children and 224 adapters exact on 512 columns, global phase included, K histogram {1:120,2:400,3:480,4:254,5:64,6:432,7:416,8:476,9:246,16:8}, about 33 s CPU; 12 semantic controls rejected (phase, input character, CZ term, translation, swapped wrappers, direction, gate order, F_r sign, C_[r] as one gate, adapter port, adapter role, frame basis), positive reordered-rows control passes. 26 tests pass. All 224 endpoint monomials satisfy q(Gx) = q(x), so the D/P order is pinned by the children controls and FX1, not by adapters.
author: Sagar Thakrar (thakrarsagar)
ai_assistance: Substantial: Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code. Parallel read-only scout and judge subagents selected the question (both judges ranked it first); four read-only reader subagents and a synthesizer extracted the specification from the Lean files, the capsule and the producer code (read as specification only); the kernel and verifier were then written fresh and checked by the calibration fixtures and controls. A post-PR adversarial review (three reviewers and a verifier) corrected the description of the producer's check (complete but not independent), the scope headline, the identity-adapter count and the credits, and added evaluator-level and inventory negative tests.
